scope: Real packed-ROM compilation, linked graphics and palettes, collision provenance, actor bindings, hardware budgets, and invalid-input rejection. Full-script VM; no browser layout claims.

results.name: Compiles actual linked ROM into selected actor and fixed-room specifications
Expands nonadjacent 8×16 tiles with vertical flip, origin, palette, and priority intact
Legacy tile animation uses centered eight-pixel geometry and linked tile ID
Event types become observational bits without rewriting ordered authoring events
Linked metatile quadrants override tile properties at their exact four cells
Unsupported raw collision properties fail with a location and named property
Metatile cells detached by packed-build reconciliation do not add invisible collision
Metatile hazard override fails even when its source raw tile is empty
Missing required player state fails explicitly
Looping attack is rejected before runtime generation
Looping target hurt animation is rejected
Optional target can be omitted without changing the source entity
Optional jump binding is compiled separately when authored
Empty hit and hurt boxes remain authorable with actionable runtime warnings
Out-of-range piece offsets are rejected without byte wrapping
Expanded second half of an 8×16 piece also obeys signed offset bounds
More than four contact boxes in an executed frame fails clearly
Out-of-range contact dimensions fail clearly
More than 24 expanded hardware pieces per frame is rejected
Player and fixed target plus static room OAM enforce eight sprites per scanline
Static decorative OAM uses packed linked bytes and screen Y coordinates
Player feet origin must keep the body inside the room
Player cannot spawn intersecting the authored solid floor
Camera scrolling requires an explicit fixed-room configuration change
Excluded or absent selected room is rejected
Different visible palette colors in a referenced source scene fail instead of recoloring
Unused source palette rows may differ and transparent slot differences are harmless
Changing selected actor identity after the base build fails instead of misbinding
Compiler rejects a gameplay32 KB ROM as the required viewer16 KB input
